description: This Java source file defines a singleton class `ThingModifyCommandMappingStrategies` that provides mapping strategies (from string identifiers to JsonifiableMapper instances) for different types of 'thing modify' commands within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It organizes mappings for commands like creation, modification, deletion of things, and related attributes, features, ACLs, and policies.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandMappingStrategies
classes.description: Singleton class that provides mapping strategies from command type identifiers to their corresponding JsonifiableMapper implementations for 'thing modify' commands.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes the mapping strategies map with command types and corresponding mapper functions.

methods.name: addTopLevelMappingStrategies
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for top-level 'thing' commands such as create, modify, delete, and modify policy ID.

methods.name: addDefinitionMappingStrategies
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for 'thing' definition-related commands.

methods.name: addAclMappingStrategies
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for ACL-related commands.

methods.name: addAttributeMappingStrategies
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for attribute-related commands.

methods.name: addFeatureMappingStrategies
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for feature and feature property commands.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of the class.

methods.name: createThingFrom
methods.description: Creates a CreateThing object from an Adaptable.

methods.name: modifyThingFrom
methods.description: Creates a ModifyThing object from an Adaptable.

methods.name: thingToCreateOrModifyFrom
methods.description: Extracts or constructs a Thing object from an Adaptable, ensuring the entity ID consistency.

methods.name: modifyPolicyIdFrom
methods.description: Creates a ModifyPolicyId command object from an Adaptable.

methods.name: initialPolicyForCreateThingFrom
methods.description: Extracts the inline initial policy for creating a thing from the Adaptable payload.

methods.name: policyIdOrPlaceholderForCreateThingFrom
methods.description: Extracts the policy ID or placeholder for creating a thing from the Adaptable payload.

methods.name: initialPolicyForModifyThingFrom
methods.description: Extracts the inline initial policy for modifying a thing from the Adaptable payload.

methods.name: policyIdOrPlaceholderForModifyThingFrom
methods.description: Extracts the policy ID or placeholder for modifying a thing from the Adaptable payload.
